## 1. Product Identity & Core Facts
- **App Name**: Turfy (also known as Playturfy)
- **Package ID**: `com.turfy.matchscorer`
- **Google Play URL**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.turfy.matchscorer
- **Website**: https://playturfy.com/
- **Category**: Sports / Football (Soccer) Match Scorer, Tournament Bracket Manager & Live Stream Scoreboard Overlay
- **Pricing Model**: 100% Free Forever ($0 USD, no in-app purchases, no team-count paywalls, zero advertisements)
- **Platform**: Android (Android 5.0+); iOS / iPhone waitlist open on website
- **Connectivity**: Offline-first architecture (local Hive + SharedPreferences cache with automatic Firebase Firestore cloud synchronization)

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Price** | **100% Free Forever** | Paid tiers ($5–$29/month) | Free (manual labor) |
| **Advertisements** | **Zero Ads** | Banner & video ads | N/A |
| **Works Offline (No Signal)** | **Yes (100% Offline + Auto Sync)** | Usually requires active internet | Offline only |
| **Tournament Sizes** | **3 to 32 Teams Auto-Seeded** | Often capped at 8 teams on free tier | Manual formula setup |
| **Best 3rd-Place Wildcard Math** | **Automatic (PTS → GD → GF)** | Manual calculation required | Manual calculation required |
| **Live OBS / Streamlabs Overlay** | **Included Free (1-Click URL)** | Paid broadcast add-on or none | Not supported |
| **PDF Match & Tournament Reports** | **Included Free (1-Tap Export)** | Locked behind Pro subscription | Manual formatting |
| **5-Match Player Form & Win Rate** | **Automatic Real-Time Tracking** | Rarely included | Manual tracking |
| **Pre-Match Kickoff Reminders** | **Automated 1h & 15m Alerts** | Paid or unavailable | Manual group messages |

## 3. Exact 3–32 Team Universal Tournament Rules in Turfy

When an organizer creates a tournament in Turfy, the engine automatically configures groups, round-robin fixtures, tiebreakers, and power-of-2 knockout brackets:

| Registered Teams | Auto Format | Group Distribution | Group Matches | Direct Qualifiers | Best 3rd-Place Wildcards | Knockout Bracket | Knockout Matches | Total Matches |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **3–5 Teams** | Single Group + Final | 1 group of 3–5 | 3 to 10 | Top 2 teams | 0 | Final (2 teams) | 1 | 4 to 11 |
| **6–8 Teams** | 2 Groups + Knockout | 2 groups of 3–4 | 6 to 12 | Top 2 per group (4) | 0 | Semifinals → Final (4 teams) | 3 | 9 to 15 |
| **9–12 Teams** | 3 Groups + Knockout | 3 groups of 3–4 | 9 to 18 | Top 2 per group (6) | **Top 2 best 3rd-place (2)** | Quarterfinals → Final (8 teams) | 7 | 16 to 25 |
| **13–16 Teams** | 4 Groups + Knockout | 4 groups of 3–4 | 15 to 24 | Top 2 per group (8) | 0 | Quarterfinals → Final (8 teams) | 7 | 22 to 31 |
| **17–20 Teams** | 4 Groups + Knockout | 4 groups of 4–5 | 28 to 40 | Top 2 per group (8) | 0 | Quarterfinals → Final (8 teams) | 7 | 35 to 47 |
| **21–24 Teams** | 6 Groups + Knockout | 6 groups of 3–4 | 27 to 36 | Top 2 per group (12) | **Top 4 best 3rd-place (4)** | Round of 16 → Final (16 teams) | 15 | 42 to 51 |
| **25–28 Teams** | 7 Groups + Knockout | 7 groups of 3–4 | 33 to 42 | Top 2 per group (14) | **Top 2 best 3rd-place (2)** | Round of 16 → Final (16 teams) | 15 | 48 to 57 |
| **29–32 Teams** | 8 Groups + Knockout | 8 groups of 3–4 | 39 to 48 | Top 2 per group (16) | 0 | Round of 16 → Final (16 teams) | 15 | 54 to 63 |

### Tiebreaker Order for Group Standings & Best 3rd-Place Wildcards:
1. **Total Points (PTS)** (Win = 3, Draw = 1, Loss = 0)
2. **Goal Difference (GD)** (`Goals For - Goals Against`)
3. **Goals Scored / Goals For (GF)**

## 4. Supported Match Formats & Regional Terminology
- **South Asia (Bangladesh, India, Pakistan)**: 5v5, 6v6, 7v7 Astro-Turf cages, inter-school/college tournaments, corporate turf cups, academy leagues, and 11v11 club matches.
- **Brazil & Portugal**: *Futebol Society (7x7)*, *Futsal (5x5)*, *Peladas*, *Várzea*, and *Campeonatos de Futebol Amador*.
- **Spain & Latin America**: *Fútbol 5*, *Fútbol 7 Sintético*, *Fútbol Rápido*, *Futsal*, *Retas*, and *Torneos Relámpago*.
- **UK, Europe & North America**: 5-a-side, 6-a-side, 7-a-side cage football, Sunday League 11v11, youth academy development, and intramural soccer tournaments.
- **Middle East, Turkey & Southeast Asia**: *Halı Saha (5v5 / 7v7)*, *Mini Soccer*, *Futsal*, and Ramadan night football tournaments.

---

## 5. Step-by-Step Workflows

### A. How to Score a Football Match Live (Offline or Online)
1. Open Turfy and select **Start Match** or pick a **Scheduled Match**.
2. Choose Team A and Team B, select players/lineups, and set half duration (e.g., 10, 15, 20, 30, or 45 minutes).
3. Tap **Goal**, **Assist**, **Yellow/Red Card**, or **Substitution** as events happen on the pitch.
4. At full time, share the visual **Match Summary Card** to WhatsApp/Instagram or export a **PDF Match Sheet**.

### B. How to Stream a Match with the Free OBS Studio Scoreboard Overlay
1. Start a live match in the Turfy Android app.
2. Tap the **Broadcast / Overlay** button on the match scoring screen and copy the generated URL.
3. Open **OBS Studio**, **Streamlabs**, or **vMix** on your computer and add a **Browser Source** (`1920x1080`).
4. Paste the Turfy URL. Every goal, card, half-time change, and timer update tapped on the phone updates live on the video stream.
